title: Does More Compute Make Every Adversarial Attack Transferable?
abstract: arXiv:2504.20310v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transferable attacks, or transferable jailbreaks, are a particularly strong version of adversarial examples that fool all defenders in a class. In this work, we study when more compute enables transferable attacks. We show that, when there is a quadratic gap in computational resources between attacker and defender, every learnable classification task admits either a transferable attack or an adversarial defense. For generative tasks, this dichotomy fails below a quadratic gap, i.e., more compute for the attacker does not lead to a transferable attack.   We prove a stronger result that implies this failure: a defense that spends additional computation after it sees the input can be provably strictly stronger than every defense that publishes a fixed model. translated_title: 更多的算力能否让每一种对抗攻击都具备可迁移性？
translated_abstract: 可迁移攻击，或称可迁移越狱攻击，是一种特别强大的对抗样本形式，能够欺骗某一类中的所有防御者。在这项工作中，我们研究了在什么条件下更多的算力能够实现可迁移攻击。我们证明，当攻击者与防御者之间存在计算资源的二次方差距时，每个可学习的分类任务要么存在可迁移攻击，要么存在对抗防御。而对于生成任务，在低于二次方差距的情况下这种二分性不再成立，即攻击者拥有更多算力并不必然带来可迁移攻击。我们证明了一个蕴含上述失效性的更强结果：一种在看到输入之后才花费额外计算的防御方法，可以被证明严格强于所有发布固定模型的防御方法。这一结果为“增加推理时算力可以提升鲁棒性”提供了形式化证据，这与Zaremba等人（2025）的实验观察相一致。我们假设存在一个……
tldr: 本文证明了在攻击者与防御者之间存在二次方算力差距时，所有可学习分类任务要么存在可迁移攻击要么存在对抗防御，而生成任务在低于该差距时不满足此二分性，且推理时使用额外计算的防御方法可被证明严格优于所有发布固定模型的防御。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that with a quadratic compute gap between attacker and defender, every learnable classification task admits either a transferable attack or an adversarial defense, this dichotomy fails for generative tasks below a quadratic gap, and a defense that spends extra computation after seeing the input can be provably strictly stronger than every defense that publishes a fixed model.
